description: CalcDeltaB integrates magnetic contributions from magnetospheric, field-aligned and ionospheric currents. The IDL postprocessor calculates ground magnetic disturbances from simulation outputs for selected locations and individual time steps. The resource is documented by NASA GSFC CCMC. The documented physical domain is Geospace; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. It excludes induction associated with ground conductivity and has no built-in time advance. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
